en: Let me live and I'll never shoot another miner. I promise.

en: Believe it or not, I used to faint at the sight of blood.
zh: 信不信由你，我以前见血就晕。

zh: 比起我上一家急诊室，这儿算什么。

Come back when you've got a wound for me to heal.
Can't help you unless you're hurt.
Let me help you with that.
Hold still and I'll see what I can do.

en: I'll give you something for that wound.
You'll feel better in no time.
Here, let me take a look at that.

zh: 祈祷吧，矿工，你没有机会的。

en: I'm not gonna beg for my life.

en: I'm going back to Earth when this is over.
Parker, I almost didn't recognize you.
zh: 帕克，我差点没认出你来。

en: Don't worry, I won't give you away, Parker.
zh: 放心，我不会出卖你的，帕克。

en: You just stay out of my way, buddy.
I hope this is all over soon.
I'll go back to work, I promise.

en: Maybe we should just give up.
It's quiet out there. Too quiet.
Hey, aren't you one of us?
Sure glad you're on our side, Parker.
zh: 真庆幸你站在我们这边，帕克。

en: I'll stay here and hold this position.
My orders are to stay here.
zh: 我接到的命令是待在这儿。

en: I'm sorry, I can't help you.
Put your weapon away so I can help you.
zh: 把武器收起来，我才能帮你。

en: Put the weapon away or bleed, your choice.
zh: 收起武器，或者继续流血，你自己选。

en: Quit waving that thing in my face.
zh: 别拿那玩意儿在我脸前晃。

en: You want help? Then holster it.
zh: 想要帮忙？那就把枪收起来。

en: Don't kill me. I'm a nurse.
I can't help you if I'm dead!
You wouldn't shoot a woman, would you?
Go find a doctor. I can't help anyone right now.
zh: 去找医生吧，我现在谁也帮不了。

en: I can't heal you. No more supplies.
I'm out of medical supplies. Would you like a lollipop?
zh: 医疗物资用完了。要不要来根棒棒糖？

en: My supplies are all gone. Maybe someone else can help you.
zh: 我的药品全没了，也许别人能帮你。

en: Patch them up and send them back. That's my motto.
zh: 包好了就送回去，这是我的座右铭。

en: Ugh, the doctors here are such pompous jerks.
zh: 唉，这儿的医生一个个自大得要命。

en: Ugh, this is nothing compared to the last ER I worked in.
zh: 唉，比起我上一家急诊室，这儿算什么。

en: Six more hours until my shift is over.
And I thought I had it tough at the nursing home.
zh: 我还以为在养老院就够苦了。

en: If I survive this, I'm going to vet school.
zh: 要是能活下来，我就去读兽医。

en: It was this or an ER back on Earth.
zh: 要么来这儿，要么回地球的急诊室。

en: I'm working here to pay off my student loans.
zh: 我在这儿干活是为了还助学贷款。

en: Okay, you're starting to creep me out.
zh: 好了，你开始让我发毛了。

en: You're the guy who started all this.
zh: 这一切就是你挑起来的。

en: If you're not wounded, you're in the wrong place.
zh: 没受伤的话，你来错地方了。

en: If you're healthy, you don't belong here.
zh: 身体好好的，就别待在这儿。

en: Move on, I have wounded to attend to.
zh: 走吧，我还有伤员要照顾。

en: I'm not wasting supplies on healthy people.
zh: 我不会把药浪费在健康人身上。

en: You want me to patch that for you?
Let's take a look at that.
A little antibiotic and you're on your way.
zh: 上点抗生素你就能走了。

en: Hold still and let me do my job.
Oh, that looks nasty, but I can handle it.
zh: 哟，看着挺吓人，不过我能处理。

en: I'll fix you up, but don't tell anyone.
Go away or I'll call the guards.
This is a classified area! Guards!
Some of my best friends are miners.
zh: 我最好的朋友里就有矿工。

en: I can't wait to get back to Earth.
I love it here on Mars.
I don't have time for this.
I just want to work in peace.
zh: 我只想安安静静地干活。

en: If I live through this, I'm going back to Earth.
zh: 要是能活着出去，我就回地球。

en: Why does there have to be so much killing?
zh: 为什么非得死这么多人？

en: When my shift's over, I'm gonna go play video games.
You should get out of here before you get in trouble.
zh: 趁没惹上麻烦，你还是快走吧。

en: Hey, you're with the Red Faction.

zh: 通缉令上那个人就是你。

en: I'm not taking sides in this conflict.
My place is here with my work.
zh: 我的位置在这儿，守着我的活。

en: Please, don't ask me to interfere.
There's nothing for you here. Please leave.
zh: 这儿没你要的东西，请走吧。

en: Come back later. I have no time now.
Ultor has been very good to me.
Just let me do my work, okay?
Don't you have somewhere else to be?
zh: 你不该待在别的地方吗？

en: Leave, please. Guards will be here soon.
